from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,subprocess,sys
root=Path("/tmp/macro-group11077-proof-20261111-2108")
def digest(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def module(path,name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod);return mod
def worker(version):
    source=root/version
    sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    import pytest
    from engine import group_earnings as ge
    from lib import config
    contract=module(root/"after/tests/test_group_earnings_contract.py","group_contract_proof")
    surface=module(root/"after/tests/test_group_read_surface.py","group_surface_proof")
    surface.DETAIL=source/"templates/basket_detail.html.j2"
    target=root/"audit"/version;target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    class FixedDatetime(datetime):
        @classmethod
        def now(cls,tz=None):return cls(2026,11,11,21,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    def public_write(folder,bid):
        out=ge.write_earnings_pulse(folder)
        if out is None:
            assert not (folder/"earnings_pulse.json").exists()
            parsed=None
        else:
            raw=(folder/"earnings_pulse.json").read_bytes()
            parsed=json.loads(raw);assert parsed==out
            json.dumps(parsed,allow_nan=False)
            assert bid in parsed and contract.validate_pulse(parsed[bid])==[]
        assert not ge.sympathy_ledger_path().exists()
        html=surface._run("GRE = "+json.dumps(parsed)+"; process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(grEarningsSection("+json.dumps(bid)+") + grEarnTileBody(GRE && GRE["+json.dumps(bid)+"])));")
        en,zh=surface._langs(html)
        return {"payload":parsed,"html":html,"en":en,"zh":zh,"artifact_sha256":None if out is None else digest(raw),"ledger_advanced":False}
    results={"version":version,"source_pin":"16e874433e0ff0fb0ad863b839deb1d16f824005"}
    # Canonical committed slice. Only MAG7 qualifies as a complete price membership.
    files=json.loads((root/"input-manifest.json").read_text())["files"]
    for item in files:
        if item["path"].startswith("data/"):
            assert digest((root/"committed"/item["path"]).read_bytes())==item["sha256"]
    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
        data=root/"committed/data"
        mp.setattr(config,"data_dir",lambda:data);mp.setenv("COLLECT_LANE","express")
        mp.setattr(ge,"datetime",FixedDatetime)
        mem=ge._membership()
        members=[m["ticker"] for m in mem["baskets"]["mag7"]["members"]]
        assert set(members)=={"AAPL","AMZN","GOOGL","META","MSFT","NVDA","TSLA"}
        all_tickers=sorted({m["ticker"] for b in mem["baskets"].values() for m in b["members"] if m.get("ticker")})
        closes=ge._member_closes(all_tickers);grid=pd.DatetimeIndex(closes.index)
        assert set(closes.columns)==set(members)
        raw_spy=ge.store.read("yahoo","SPY")
        observed=pd.to_numeric(raw_spy["close"],errors="coerce")
        observed.index=pd.DatetimeIndex(observed.index).as_unit("ms")
        observed=observed[~observed.index.duplicated(keep="last")].sort_index()
        observed=observed.where(np.isfinite(observed)).reindex(grid)
        aligned=ge._spy_close(grid);assert aligned is not None
        recent=grid[-min(len(grid),ge.WINDOW_Q*ge.SESSIONS_PER_QUARTER):]
        actual=public_write(target/"committed","mag7")
        assert actual["payload"]["mag7"]["season"]["n_members"]==7
        actual.update({"materialized_price_members":sorted(closes.columns),"registry_baskets":len(mem["baskets"]),
          "emitted_baskets_not_all_qualified":len(actual["payload"]),"sessions":len(grid),
          "first_session":grid.min().date().isoformat(),"last_session":grid.max().date().isoformat(),
          "benchmark_observed_on_grid":int(observed.notna().sum()),
          "benchmark_aligned_nonnull":int(aligned.notna().sum()),
          "sympathy_window_sessions":len(recent),
          "missing_spy_in_sympathy_window":[d.date().isoformat() for d in recent if pd.isna(observed.loc[d])],
          "spy_daily_returns_in_sympathy_window":int(observed.pct_change(fill_method=None).loc[recent].notna().sum()),
          "mag7":actual["payload"]["mag7"]})
        # Keep the complete written-file hash, but don't qualify other partial baskets.
        del actual["payload"]
        results["committed_mag7"]=actual
    modes=["complete","missing_end","null_end","missing_start","null_start","single_old_quote",
           "interior_gap","last_null_duplicate","last_invalid_duplicate","last_valid_duplicate",
           "infinite_end","absent","all_null","all_nonfinite"]
    cases={}
    for mode in modes:
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
            folder=target/"synthetic"/mode
            data,sessions,event,endpoint=contract._benchmark_writer_tree(folder,mp)
            path=data/"yahoo/SPY.parquet";spy=pd.read_parquet(path)
            if mode=="missing_end":spy=spy.drop(endpoint)
            elif mode=="null_end":spy.loc[endpoint,"close"]=np.nan
            elif mode=="missing_start":spy=spy.drop(event)
            elif mode=="null_start":spy.loc[event,"close"]=np.nan
            elif mode=="single_old_quote":spy=spy.iloc[:1]
            elif mode=="interior_gap":spy=spy.drop(sessions[-5])
            elif mode in ("last_null_duplicate","last_invalid_duplicate","last_valid_duplicate"):
                value={"last_null_duplicate":None,"last_invalid_duplicate":"bad","last_valid_duplicate":102.0}[mode]
                spy=pd.concat([spy,pd.DataFrame({"close":[value]},index=[endpoint])])
                if isinstance(value,str):spy["close"]=spy["close"].astype(str)
                spy=spy.sort_index(kind="stable")
            elif mode=="infinite_end":spy.loc[endpoint,"close"]=np.inf
            elif mode=="all_null":spy["close"]=np.nan
            elif mode=="all_nonfinite":spy["close"]=np.inf
            if mode=="absent":path.unlink()
            else:spy.to_parquet(path)
            cases[mode]=public_write(folder/"site/basketdata","benchmark")
    results["synthetic_drift"]=cases
    rich_cases={}
    for mode,offset,value in [("complete",None,None),("missing_report",-20,None),
                              ("missing_prior",-21,None),("quiet_gap",-10,None),
                              ("nonfinite_report",-20,float("inf"))]:
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
            folder=target/"sympathy"/mode
            fixture=contract._write_tree(folder,mp)
            mp.setenv("COLLECT_LANE","express");mp.setattr(ge,"datetime",FixedDatetime)
            if offset is not None:
                path=config.data_dir()/"yahoo/SPY.parquet";spy=pd.read_parquet(path)
                if value is None:spy=spy.drop(fixture["sessions"][offset])
                else:spy.loc[fixture["sessions"][offset],"close"]=value
                spy.to_parquet(path)
            rich_cases[mode]=public_write(folder/"site/basketdata","rich")
    results["synthetic_sympathy"]=rich_cases
    output=target/"consumer-proof.json";output.write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({"version":version,"json_sha256":digest(output.read_bytes()),"synthetic_shapes":len(cases)+len(rich_cases),
      "mag7_sessions":results["committed_mag7"]["sessions"],"mag7_drift":results["committed_mag7"]["mag7"]["drift"],
      "mag7_sympathy":results["committed_mag7"]["mag7"]["sympathy"],"missing_spy_last504":len(results["committed_mag7"]["missing_spy_in_sympathy_window"])}),flush=True)
if len(sys.argv)>1:
    worker(sys.argv[1])
else:
    records={}
    for version in ["before","after"]:
        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(Path(__file__).resolve()),version],text=True,capture_output=True)
        (root/("audit-"+version+".log")).write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
        print(r.stdout,flush=True)
        if r.returncode:print(r.stderr[-10000:],flush=True)
        assert r.returncode==0,version
        records[version]=json.loads((root/"audit"/version/"consumer-proof.json").read_text())
    before,after=records["before"],records["after"]
    changed=[]
    def diff(a,b,path=""):
        if isinstance(a,dict) and isinstance(b,dict):
            assert a.keys()==b.keys(),path
            for key in a:diff(a[key],b[key],path+"."+key)
        elif a!=b:changed.append({"path":path,"before":a,"after":b})
    diff(before["committed_mag7"]["mag7"],after["committed_mag7"]["mag7"],"mag7")
    for key in ["schema","authority","as_of","generated_at","season","results","guidance","revisions"]:
        assert before["committed_mag7"]["mag7"][key]==after["committed_mag7"]["mag7"][key]
    rejected={"missing_end","null_end","missing_start","null_start","single_old_quote",
              "last_null_duplicate","last_invalid_duplicate","infinite_end"}
    for mode in rejected:
        obj=after["synthetic_drift"][mode]["payload"]["benchmark"]
        assert obj["drift"]=={"pos_share_5d":None,"n":0},mode
    for mode in ["complete","interior_gap","last_valid_duplicate"]:
        assert after["synthetic_drift"][mode]["payload"]==before["synthetic_drift"][mode]["payload"],mode
        assert after["synthetic_drift"][mode]["payload"]["benchmark"]["drift"]=={"pos_share_5d":0.0,"n":4}
    for mode in ["absent","all_null","all_nonfinite"]:assert after["synthetic_drift"][mode]["payload"] is None,mode
    for mode in ["missing_report","missing_prior","nonfinite_report"]:
        assert after["synthetic_sympathy"][mode]["payload"]["rich"]["sympathy"]["n_events"]==47,mode
    assert after["synthetic_sympathy"]["quiet_gap"]["payload"]["rich"]["sympathy"]["n_events"]==48
    receipt={"pin":before["source_pin"],"mag7_changed_fields":changed,"mag7_full_object_equal":not changed,
      "synthetic_drift_shapes":14,"synthetic_sympathy_shapes":5,"versions":records,
      "source_limits":["Actual public helper writer and section/tile consumer only; not full scripts.build_baskets",
       "Only MAG7's complete seven-member committed price slice is qualified",
       "Keep-last applies to existing store reader output order; raw duplicate ordering is not repaired",
       "Nonpositive benchmark prices and invalid member prices are outside this observed-date repair",
       "No browser, full-page, deployment, historical-ledger regeneration or trading validation"]}
    path=root/"consumer-audit.json";path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({"mag7_full_object_equal":not changed,"changed_fields":changed,"synthetic_shapes":19,
       "artifact":str(path),"sha256":digest(path.read_bytes()),"bytes":path.stat().st_size}),flush=True)
